searchText: LH is passing all tests thanks for the nightly, that’s awesome I do have a few more tests locally that I didn't get to push before we merged #5094, those are testing epoch boundary cases where we have 1, 2, or even 5 epochs of missed blocks, I don't think we need them for alpha.5 5 epochs of missed blocks with exists/deposits/consolidation requests on the last Payload should definitely be there Not necessarily in the release But we need those tests for sure. It's important that enough requests are in the last payload And that slot zero is missed what do you mean by "enough", I just have one of each right now https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5127 A single operation may not change duties nor effective balances for the next epoch Will review your tests tomorrow
